denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: September 14, 2023
Claim: Infusion therapy, August 2023
Reason Code: CO-D9

Benefits are not available for the above service. The therapy is considered experimental or
investigational and is excluded under Section 6.1 of your Certificate of Coverage. The submitted
documentation shows the drug is FDA-approved and was administered for the indication stated on
its labeling.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.

sub_claims.draft_rationale: The policy explicitly excludes benefits for experimental or investigational services (Section 6.1). However, Section 6.3 provides an exception to this exclusion by stating that a drug or biological approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration and administered consistent with its labeled indications is not considered Experimental or Investigational. Therefore, the evidence cuts both ways.
